8.18.8.3. iLock_Geography.lcf.api.LCFWorkflow.addLCF2Inst¶

LCFWorkflow.addLCF2Inst(lcf2inst)¶

Add instantiation rules. You may either provide a path to to a file in the LCF2Inst format, or a dict mapping user type names to lists of InstRule instances.
